ROUND 2, REMAINING: (1) the NEW lore Reference concept "Ward's stderr output contract" (the leader ruled OPTION A; do NOT edit the spec-of-record pointer, WARD_MVP_AGENT_SPEC.md or ADR 0019, because ADR 0019 forbids copying spec text into the pointer). It states: the exact --json line {"warning":"tpm_session_leaked"}; code only, never a path or handle; it can precede the error envelope; the envelope is always the last stderr line; and the human-mode sentence ("warning: tpm_session_leaked: a TPM session slot may be leaked; it is cleared by a reset or reboot."). Create it through lore, pin its sentences with a test (as the ADR 0028 sentence is pinned in test/key-backend.test.ts), link it from ADR 0028, and add it to a lore agent profile's sources (implementation and verification) without changing max_tokens; if it cannot fit, STOP and tell the leader rather than narrowing an ADR. Write the register line (mutant: the concept sentence deleted) BEFORE the run. Run lore check and scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs. (2) After that: push, wait for green by ref, make a fresh review worktree for the new head, report to the leader. Do not merge #341 before the Opus round-2 verdict.

(a23) IS IN FORCE (verbatim on WCLI-21): keep the specific Linux init codes and the init hint noting Secret Service is not implemented; the warning is stderr, one --json line, a sentence in human mode; the contract is documented. (a22) in force too (Secret Service a NAMED GAP, blob dir <wardDir>/tpm/<vaultId>/ mode 0700, refuse-never-chmod).

WCLI-158: AC1 is CHECKED; AC0 STAYS OPEN until the Opus round-2 review confirms the drain tests (the leader decides). WCLI-168 (amend ADR 0028 to name the blob directory) is FILED, NOT STARTED, its own small docs PR after #341 lands. SLICE 3d-2 (status and doctor: rule 4 backend in use, diagnoseTpm2 into doctor checks, (a19) tool_untrusted with the word "untrusted" in human output and JSON, NN1, key_unloadable strings unchanged, N6, the CRLF comment fix, "Secret Service: not implemented" by name, observeKey must THREAD .tpm2 through KeyObservation into tpm2StateFor and map vault_key_ambiguous with its store names) is NOT STARTED and needs the leader's brief.
